decisions.target_truth: Keep artificial=human-made/not natural and figurative artificial=insincere/affected; both are ordinary useful extensions.
Single ordinary artist/creator-of-art center is correct and sufficient.
Keep relating to art/artists and aesthetically/artistically skillful or pleasing; both are coherent modern uses.

Preserve time, manner/comparison, cause, and role uses, plus high-value constructions as...as and as if/as though. Current learner map is appropriately rich without requiring more dictionary splitting.

Center rise/go upward and climb/go up something. Preserve ascend the throne once as a formal figurative accession application, not both under generic climbing and a duplicate separate sense. Demote genealogical 'go back/up in succession' to recognition/reference.
Keep ascertain=find out/determine with certainty, including ascertain whether; current single high-value center is coherent.
Keep ascribe sth to sb/sth=attribute something to a cause/source; one sense plus construction is appropriate.

Center ash/ashes=powdery residue after burning. Keep ash tree/ash wood only as lower lexical recognition if retained. Demote the very marginal verb ash=turn into ashes from ordinary Active learner content.
Keep ashamed of sth/sb and ashamed to do=feeling shame/guilt; current single center and patterns are coherent.
Keep toward/onto shore and on land/shore as a compact directional-location distinction; current patterns are useful.

Center aside=to/on one side and preserve high-value aside from=apart from/besides; theatrical noun aside may remain lower recognition. Do not promote the separate meanings of phrasal verbs set/put sth aside as multiple independent lexical senses of the adverb aside.

Center ask=seek information and ask=request/invite, with ask sb sth/about, ask for sth, and ask sb to do sth as high-value structures. Collapse construction duplicates already represented by fixed collocations. Keep formal ask sth of sb / require-demand uses lower rather than equal A-priority learner objects.

Keep asleep=in a state of sleep and body-part asleep=numb as the active learner branches. Remove deprecated euphemistic dead/long asleep wording from Core; do not let inactive historical senses remain named in the learner center.

Use one ordinary learner center aspect=feature/side/part of a subject rather than two near-duplicate Active senses ('aspect' vs 'characteristic'). Keep grammatical aspect only as specialized recognition.
Keep aspire to sth / aspire to be=strongly aim or hope to achieve; current single learner center is correct.

Restore Active assassinate=murder a prominent/political/public figure as the ordinary main sense. Keep figurative assassinate a reputation only as low recognition if retained; Current v4 zero-Active state is not learnable.
Keep noun assault=violent attack and verb assault=attack violently; noun/verb distinction is useful and current owner is coherent.
Keep assemble parts=put together and assemble people=gather/come together. The merged intransitive people-gather use is correctly represented within the second branch.
Keep assembly=gathered group/meeting, process of putting parts together, and an assembled unit/component; all are useful and clearly related.

Keep assert that/assert a claim=state firmly and assert rights/authority=insist on or make recognized. The assert-that construction is explicitly presentation-merged into its fixed collocation and does not create a competing meaning.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
Deprecated/reference-only senses must not continue to define Core/Word Feel when they are intentionally outside the active learner map.
